jobs.title: Senior People Specialist (HR Operations & Strategy) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Kurzbeschreibung SPREAD baut Engineering Intelligence für komplexe Produkte. Unsere AI-native Plattform gibt Automobilherstellern, Rüstungsunternehmen und Industriekonzernen eine vernetzte Sicht auf ihre Produktdaten. Volkswagen, BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Bosch und Rheinmetall arbeiten bereits damit. Hinter uns stehen HV Capital, DTCP, La Famiglia und Salesforce. Wir haben den SPARK AI Innovation Award gewonnen und stehen auf LinkedIns Liste der Top-Startups in DACH. Die Rolle. Du baust die People-Programme von SPREAD auf: Performance, Karrierepfade, Compensation und Leadership Development. Von Februar bis November übernimmst du vertretungsweise unsere HR-Operations-Prozesse, die bereits gut eingespielt sind. Daneben bleibt genug Zeit, um parallel mit den ersten Strategiethemen zu starten. Ab November kommt unser Kollege aus HR Operations in Teilzeit zurück und übernimmt die Prozesse wieder. Ab dann liegt dein Fokus klar auf Strategie und Programmen. Du berichtest an Jasmina (People Lead). Unser People-Team ist bewusst schlank: Neben dir und Jasmina gehört eine Werkstudentin dazu, die das Office Management verantwortet und in HR hineinwächst, und ab November wieder unser Kollege aus HR Operations. Wir setzen auf Talentdichte statt Headcount, und deine Programme sorgen dafür, dass Leistung sichtbar wird und sich lohnt. KI gehört bei uns überall dazu, im People-Team genauso. Sie setzt deine Gedanken schneller um, das Denken bleibt bei dir. Du bist mindestens drei Tage pro Woche bei uns im Office an der Köpenicker Straße, das ist gesetzt, denn HR passiert hier vor Ort. Wenn du Bock hast, People-Arbeit nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern aufzubauen, lies weiter. Deine Verantwortung Du gestaltest und fährst unseren Performance-Zyklus, von Evaluation-Frameworks über Kalibrierung bis zum Talent Board, damit Entscheidungen über Entwicklung und Gehalt nachvollziehbar sind. Du entwickelst Career Frameworks und Leveling weiter, damit jede:r weiß, wo sie oder er steht und was als N

jobs.title: Founding Talent Lead
jobs.description: Role We are hiring someone to build up and own our talent function end-to-end. Recruiting, developing and retaining the best people is absolutely fundamental to our success. It’s also one of the most fun parts of building. Together with our founders, you will build and own the entire talent stack: we’ll start with sourcing and winning the best talent (including building a long-term talent pool that we can rely on as we scale), and then move into building performance reviews and people development. We have come this far because we have the best people, and we will go further because we keep finding them. Your job is to make sure that the biggest constraint on our growth is never people. What you will do We are scaling incredibly fast across all functions. We are 25 people today and will be a multiple of that next year. Winning talent: you find the best people for engineering, sales, and ops roles, build the channels that keep candidates coming, and help the team turn the right ones into hires. You’ll help us do whatever it takes to recruit the best talent (even if that is a creative signing present). You make sure our recruiting process is ultra fast and convincing. You define the steps, keep candidates moving fast, prepare the team for interviews, and make sure we do not lose people we wanted. When someone turns us down, you build the strategy to change their minds. Beyond immediate hiring needs, you’ll build a long-term talent network (feel free to host amazing events). People development: we don’t really have a structured process for this today. We may never. You’ll work with us on defining the right approach for performance management and people development at BEO, so we not only win the best talent but also retain and develop it. Tool stack, automation, and tool building: you own every tool in the talent stack, from ATS and outreach to scheduling, feedback, and onboarding. You'll own end-to-end recruitment across different business functions, from Product & Engineering to Go-to-Market, partnering with hiring managers to develop effective hiring strategies and deliver a great candidate experience. As internal users of our own products, you'll also collaborate with our Product teams to share feedback and identify opportunities to improve our recruitment tools and experience. Build relationships with key stakeholders and take ownership of active recruitment processes. Within 6 months: Independently manage recruitment across multiple functions, develop sourcing strategies and build talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs. After 1 year: Become a trusted business partner to hiring teams, contribute to talent acquisition strategy and drive continuous improvements across our recruitment processes and tools. What You’ll Be Doing Own end-to-end recruitment: Manage the full recruitment lifecycle across different functions, from intake meetings and sourcing to offer management. jobs.title: HR Manager Onderwijs
jobs.description: Deze HR functie combineert inhoudelijk advies met coördinatie en verantwoordelijkheid. Als HR adviseur Onderwijs bij Lyceo krijg je de ruimte om inhoudelijk impact te maken én een bredere rol binnen het team te pakken. Je ondersteunt leidinggevenden, begeleidt verzuimtrajecten, verbetert HR processen en coördineert de werkzaamheden binnen het team HR en Salaris. Een veelzijdige volgende stap voor een ervaren HR professional die inhoudelijk sterk is en al ervaring heeft met het begeleiden, coördineren of aansturen van collega's. Taken Als HR adviseur Onderwijs ondersteun je leidinggevenden bij personele vraagstukken, begeleid je verzuimtrajecten en denk je mee over beleid en organisatieontwikkeling. Tegelijkertijd zorg je voor overzicht en samenhang binnen het team HR en Salaris. Je coördineert de werkzaamheden binnen het team en bent verantwoordelijk voor recruitment, waarbij je ook de recruiter begeleidt en aanstuurt. Je blijft nadrukkelijk zelf actief in de dagelijkse HR praktijk. De ene dag begeleid je een leidinggevende bij een complex verzuimdossier, de andere dag stem je prioriteiten binnen het team af, bespreek je de voortgang van recruitment of werk je aan nieuw HR beleid. Zo verbind je HR beleid, processen en de dagelijkse praktijk met elkaar. Je kent de dynamiek van de organisatie, weet wat er op de verschillende vestigingen speelt en zorgt ervoor dat het team effectief inspeelt op wat de organisatie nodig heeft. Kortom, jij pakt de regie bij het: adviseren van leidinggevenden en management over HR en organisatievraagstukken; begeleiden van verzuimtrajecten, waaronder complexe en langdurige dossiers; ontwikkelen, implementeren en evalueren van HR-beleid en optimaliseren en borgen van HR-processen; coördineren van de werkzaamheden binnen het team HR en Salaris, inclusief recruitment, en het begeleiden en aansturen van collega's binnen het team; goed gevoel voor relevante wet en regelgeving rond arbeidsrecht, verzuim en beloning, en het vermogen om tijdig ju

jobs.description: Be part of a high-performing Recruitment team at one of America’s fastest growing companies We’re a strong team of dedicated talent specialists spread across India and the Philippines. We’ve hired and retained over 400 employees in the past few years and learned a ton along the way; what scales, what breaks, and what truly moves the needle. We’re an experiment-first team. We don’t flinch at ideas, we love them. Have a compelling idea? Pitch it. We’ll run with it. We’re equally big on learning and iteration, and today, nearly 50% of our workflows are automated, freeing our talent associates to focus on strategy and execution. Now, we’re looking for strategists who execute. People who go beyond ticking off daily tasks and think about the bigger picture: How can HR enable the business? How can HR better support the Executive Team? How can HR lead world-class talent acquisition that creates a seamless experience for candidates and hiring managers? If this sounds exciting, and you have the energy to build, experiment, and own outcomes, we’d love to hear from you. Key Responsibilities: As a member of our Recruitment team, you're going to have a wide-ranging group of responsibilities and goals. On a day-to-day basis, this means: Support prospecting and headhunting efforts. Not just finding the right candidates, but nurturing relationships early and building long-term pipelines Source candidates from diverse channels and screen resumes and applications with a strong quality bar Take hands-on ownership of role coordination that goes beyond scheduling (much of which is automated) to stay closely involved in progress, blockers, and outcomes for each role Conduct interviews and coordinate multiple rounds of assessments Partner closely with hiring managers to align on role expectations, feedback, and hiring timelines Communicate clearly with management and team members to provide regular status updates Take on additional responsibilities as needed in a fast-moving startup enviro

jobs.description: Build Europe's semiconductor future with us! Join ESMC and help shape the future of Europe’s semiconductor industry! Are you passionate about connecting people with opportunities and making recruitment processes run smoothly? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced, international environment where teamwork, ownership, and adaptability make a real difference? At ESMC, we are building more than a state-of-the-art semiconductor manufacturing facility in Dresden. We are building the team behind it. To support our growing organization, we are looking for a hands-on Talent Acquisition Specialist (m/f/d) who enjoys managing recruitment activities from start to finish, building strong relationships with hiring managers, and creating a positive candidate experience. This is a fully on-site position, allowing you to work closely with hiring managers, conduct in-person interviews, and actively contribute to our recruitment activities on site. Job Responsibilities Own the recruitment journey: Manage end-to-end recruitment activities for assigned positions, from sourcing and screening to interviews, selection, and offer coordination. Make hiring happen: Drive recruitment processes forward, ensuring timely delivery against hiring priorities and targets. Find the right talent: Identify, engage, and assess candidates through various sourcing channels, including proactive approaches for hard-to-fill positions. Partner with hiring managers: Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand hiring needs, conduct on-site interviews, align expectations, and support effective hiring decisions. Create a great candidate experience: Ensure professional, transparent, and timely communication throughout the recruitment process. Keep things organized: Maintain accurate candidate data and recruitment activities in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS). jobs.title: Lead Talent Acquisition & Employer Branding (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Imagine …you’ll be building something that doesn’t yet exist here: a shared recruitment division for our retail touchpoints across Germany and our agency divisions. You’ll shape how we attract talent in future: through shared processes, standards and key performance indicators. You’ll lead your recruitment team both in terms of discipline and expertise, filling roles in shops and retail spaces as well as in project management, creative and consultancy, whilst raising AVANTGARDE’s profile as an employer. You’ll report to the Head of Talent & Culture and act as the main point of contact for recruitment matters for the management teams of our German subsidiaries. In short: you’ll build, lead and recruit, ensuring that our teams in stores, retail spaces and at the agency start out with the right people. Your Tasks Structure of the recruitment stream: You will consolidate recruitment for Frontline and the agency into a single unit and introduce standardised processes, standards and key performance indicators. Leadership: You will provide both line management and professional guidance to your recruitment team, allocate and prioritise vacancies, and develop the team further. Recruitment & Prioritisation: Together with senior management, you will prioritise vacant roles, new store and retail space openings, and new projects; you will manage the selection process and conduct interviews yourself. Employer Branding & Channels: You will be responsible for campaigns, the careers page, LinkedIn, job portals and our referral programme, and will allocate the budget where it has the greatest impact. Key Figures & Reporting: You define KPIs such as time-to-hire and cost per hire, identify bottlenecks at an early stage and report to the Talent & Culture management team and to our clients. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Human Resources
jobs.description: Job Description We are looking for a commercially minded, hands-on Senior Human Resources Manager to lead all People & Culture functions at our Australian fulfillment center. Serving as the dedicated HR Business Partner to the Site Director, you will own the end-to-end people strategy, workforce capability, and daily HR operations for a large, multi-shift frontline and salaried workforce. Operating within a matrixed People model, you will manage an on-site HR team while partnering closely with our specialised Centres of Excellence (COEs)—including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, People Operations, and Work Health & Safety (WHS)—to translate people initiatives into practical, high-impact site execution. You will… Strategic Business Partnering Site Leadership Partnership: Act as a trusted advisor and coach to the Site Director and site department heads on organisational design, leadership effectiveness, change management, and peak-volume workforce scaling. Workforce Planning: Partner with Site Operations, Planning, and Workforce Staffing to forecast seasonal headcount requirements, optimise labour mix (permanent vs. casual/agency), and align staffing plans with production targets. Local Organizational Design & Effectiveness : Act as a thought partner and provide strategic influence to the Site Operations team when it comes to performance management, team structuring, succession planning, and ensuring team members fully understand their job expectations and accountability measures.  Site HR Operations & Team Leadership End-to-End HR Ownership: Oversee the execution and compliance of all Site HR operations, ensuring consistent, high-touch support for frontline associates, team leaders, and site managers both locally and through remote COE’s. Team Development: (where applicable) Lead, mentor, and develop an on-site HR team,  building capability and ensuring clear accountability across the employee lifecycle. Employee & Industrial Relation
